subject: Supplier record corrections + PO enablement for Acme Biotech
messages:
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Maria Gonzalez <maria.gonzalez@acme-biotech.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-07T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Supplier record corrections + PO enablement for Acme Biotech

Hi Maria / Acme team,

Thanks for agreeing to get set up with Redwood. We did a quick pass over your record in our vendor master and identified a couple of data issues that will block PO creation and ACH setup unless corrected:

- Remit address on file (Vendor ID 789): 123 Old St, Suite 100 — appears to be outdated. Can you confirm the correct remit and legal address? Your website and accounting note 987 New Avenue, Building 5.
- Duplicate vendor records: we see Vendor ID 789 and Vendor ID 120 in our system. Please confirm which ID your accounting team prefers we use for future POs.
- Bank details: we need an ACH authorization + bank routing/account (please redact account numbers in shared documents but include last 4 digits).
- Tax document: signed W-9 (or applicable tax form) for the entity we will pay.

Attached: vendor_onboarding_form.pdf (fillable) and vendor_master_snapshot_20261107.csv (export of fields we have).

Could you provide the corrected address, preferred vendor ID, and the bank/W-9 docs within five business days? If there are any constraints on sharing bank details, tell us the best secure channel. Once we have confirmation we'll kick off an internal vendor merge (if needed) and enable PO routing to the correct record.

Next steps for Redwood (internal): Marcus — please note that AP will need a merge ticket if we consolidate 789->120. Dev — looping you for PO/provider contact mapping. Monica — can you check whether any live POs are tied to 789?

Thanks — appreciate a quick confirmation so we can avoid payment delays.

Best,
Laura Bennett
Procurement Manager | Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.com
Attachment: vendor_onboarding_form.pdf (application/pdf)
Attachment: vendor_master_snapshot_20261107.csv (text/csv)

Date: 2026-11-07T13:45:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Supplier record corrections + PO enablement for Acme Biotech

Hi Laura — thanks for the heads up and the snapshot. Quick answers below: 

- Confirmed legal/remit address: Acme Biotech Ltd., 987 New Avenue, Building 5, San Francisco, CA 94107. (Previously we had an old warehouse address.)
- Preferred vendor ID: Our finance team has consolidated records and prefers Redwood to use Vendor ID 120 going forward. The legacy 789 was used by a previous DBA and should be merged into 120.
- Bank details: attached bank_details_redacted.pdf (last 4 digits: 4321). We can share a secure ACH authorization form via DocuSign if required.
- Tax form: attached w9_acme_signed.pdf.

We also attached a short note from our AP team explaining the duplicate (historical tax ID change). If you need any notarized paperwork or letter of authorization let me know.

Maria Gonzalez
Head of Finance Operations
Acme Biotech Ltd.
maria.gonzalez@acme-biotech.com

Marcus / Monica / AP team —

Following Maria's note: Acme requests we use Vendor ID 120 going forward and merge 789 into 120. Attached is a standard merge request template (merge_request_template.docx) — please open a vendor merge ticket and include: legacy ID (789), target ID (120), reason (DBA/tax ID change), and link to vendor docs (W-9 + bank redacted).

Action items: 
- AP: please confirm whether there are any outstanding POs or invoices tied to 789. If so, we need to reassign or hold until the merge is complete.
- Marcus: can you approve the merge ticket when created?
- Monica: quick check on contract system (are any SOWs tied to 789?)

Target timeline: create merge ticket today, complete internal routing by EOD Tuesday (2026-11-10) so we can enable ACH/PO to 120 mid-next-week. If AP needs additional verification (notarized letter), flag here.

Thanks — Dev
